metadata.title: अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग इतना मोहताज क्यों | NCST : A dysfunctional institution | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: National commission for Scheduled Tribes was established in year 2004. The commission is a constitutional body and has responsibility to safeguard rights of tribals in the country. It was envisaged that it will be an independent institution which will advice governments on policy related to Tribals. But the commission was never able to fulfill it’s duties.
